backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles, access control, and Stripe checkout/session operations with auto-created profiles and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining light/dark theme color variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point setting document metadata and loading the React app root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router setup defining public and protected routes with Internet Identity–based auth checks.
frontend/src/components/ai/AICaptionGene: UI component generating template-based caption suggestions with input controls and copy-to-clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeBu: Component loading the Stripe Buy Button script and rendering the embedded checkout element with fallback states.
frontend/src/components/billing/StripeCh: UI panel for editing and validating Stripe checkout URLs stored in localStorage, with save status feedback.
frontend/src/components/billing/UpgradeT: Displays upgrade options based on subscription tier and triggers Stripe checkout or buy button when available.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level app layout that loads the Stripe Buy Button script and renders header, footer, and routed content.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer with copyright, terms link, and referral link including dynamic app identifier.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with navigation, login/logout handling via Internet Identity, and logo display.
frontend/src/config/stripeCheckoutConfig: LocalStorage-based config manager for Stripe checkout settings with validation helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for loading, refreshing, and saving the caller’s user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeBuyButtonScr: Loads the Stripe Buy Button script once and provides a hook to track loading state and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoRecorder.ts: Provides a hook for recording video with MediaRecorder, including start, stop, pause, resume, and result management.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and defines light and dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/CameraPage.tsx: Camera UI page allowing photo capture and video recording with camera controls, timers, and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing user profile, subscription details, and actions like refresh, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with hero section, features, authentication-aware buttons, and Stripe Buy Button loading.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity with UI feedback for loading and errors, redirecting on successful auth.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentCancelPage.tsx: Displays a cancellation message after a failed or canceled payment and provides buttons to return to the dashboard or retry.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a success message after a completed payment and offers a button to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms of Service page with multiple sections outlining usage, licensing, accounts, and billing.
frontend/src/types/stripe-buy-button.d.t: Adds TypeScript definitions for the custom stripe-buy-button web component.
frontend/src/utils/captionGenerator.ts: Generates caption suggestions based on tone, platform, topic, and keywords using templates, emojis, and CTAs.
frontend/src/utils/subscriptionTier.ts: Provides helper functions to label and check user subscription tiers from the backend enum.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS with custom colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Contains the project's state, including architecture notes, existing features, and pending feature requests for CloudCam AI. Defines authentication rules, media constraints, access control, and tracked requirements.
